entries.name: Compact equipment factory
entries.description: Dedicated historical 3x3 parcel, 48 metres square, with a 45 metre architectural envelope. This is a NEW SMALLER FACTORY layout, never a resized 80m factory. Preserve the equipment-factory identity in the painted reference: two parallel cream-plaster machining/assembly halls with broad terracotta sawtooth roofs and three or four repeated loading bays each, a small yellow overhead gantry, a few broad stacked equipment crates, and low timber perimeter fences. Shorten the halls and reduce their number of bays for this smaller 48m plot; keep 2.1m ordinary personnel doors, 4.2m loading bays, 3m storeys and 1.2m fences at the canonical metre scale. One ordinary personnel door on a clear front-facing wall must be fully visible from head to sill. Exact fixed orthographic 2:1 ground plane: all roof ridges, hall walls, eaves, gantry rails, yard and fence edges follow +0.5/-0.5 screen slopes. No perspective convergence or camera yaw. The second native reference defines the exact pixel camera and ground anchor; retain its camera while painting the first reference materials and factory identity. Retain only necessary built paving and paths, otherwise bare yard ground is transparent; no grass lawn rectangle or foundation plinth. Broad quiet painted shapes, no text, logos, people or tiny clutter.
